_comment: Rules of `satk asset lint` (package satk.lint). The code implements the checks; this file decides
their severity, thresholds, messages and whether they run. sev: info < warn < error < fatal;
fatal = the game crashes or cannot load the file, error = it loads but is wrong (missing collision,
garbage texture, invisible model), warn = works but breaks a budget or a convention, info = advice.
msg is a str.format template filled with the fields the check passes and the scalar params of the rule.
ref names the source: gta-reversed = src/gta-reversed/source/game_sa, plugin-sdk = src/plugin-sdk-sa/plugin_sa,
research NN = docs/research/NN-*.md of the workspace. Defaults ('game' preset) are calibrated on the
vanilla game: 0 fatal, 0 error except the files the game never loads. 'strict' tightens budgets and
conventions for new content (research 22 sec. 3). A --config file overrides on top: {"rules": {id: {...}}}.

classes._comment: Model class for budgets: IDE section (objs/tobj -> map, or lod when the name contains lod_name or draw > lod_draw), else guessed from the DFF (skin -> peds, embedded COL -> cars).
classes._comment2: Classes aligned with satk.style: pickup = the pickup models of the vanilla game (by name); upgrade = definitions in an IDE whose path contains upgrade_ide; interior_shell / interior_prop = definitions in an IDE under interior_ide or DFFs of interior_archives (shell when the model is at least interior_shell_size m across). txd_class fixes the class of shared TXDs, archive_class the class of every entry of an archive (player.img holds the clothes, not the models of the same names).

strict._comment: New content (research 22 sec. 3): vanilla p90 budgets, textures <= 512, mipmaps outside vehicles/peds/weapons, pow2, night colours, collision. Vehicles are budgeted on veh.hd_tris (vanilla p90 per type); the whole file only has a cap.

vanilla._comment: Detail tier 'vanilla' (satk.style): new content that must sit unnoticed next to vanilla. Conventions vanilla follows in at least 95 % of its files are warnings; triangle counts are reported as information (vanilla p98 per model class and the vanilla maxima per vehicle part), never graded. Mipmaps stay info: vanilla vehicle, ped and weapon textures have none, most map textures below 256 px neither.

sa_plus._comment: Detail tier 'sa_plus' (satk.style, default for new assets): the vanilla visual language at a free detail level. No triangle or material budget runs (richer interiors, engine bays and lamp housings in the same style are welcome); the engine limits stay: 65,535 vertices per geometry, names, frames, TXD formats, collision, vehicle semantics.
